# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Worker 4 Slot 96: Wwise Tier-1 Contextual Music Director (oe_aud_, 0 DLC dependency, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v120_music_director.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Rule #18 Wrapper Trigger (Stage plugs oe_rule_is_world_concert_off here)
# global_var:oe_v120_rule_override:
#   unset/0 = follow Game Rule #18 (Standard prior to Stage wiring)
#   1       = Standard Full Mode (Dev Page 88 live override)
#   2       = Concert & Resolutions Only (Music Director remains ON)
#   3       = Off / Silent Compatibility Mode (O(1) sleep)
# STAGE_PLUG_RULE_18_OFF: Stage adds
#   AND = { NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 2 } oe_rule_is_world_concert_off = yes }
# inside the OR block below.
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. True when Game Rule #18 (or Dev Page 88 override = 3) disables the Music Director.
oe_aud_rule_is_off = {
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 3
		AND = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 1 }
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 2 }
			oe_rule_is_world_concert_off = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when this country can receive a contextual Wwise music cue right now.
oe_aud_can_play_cue = {
	is_ai = no
	is_human = yes
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { oe_aud_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_muted }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_cue_cd }
}
